On Wed, Jul 10, 2013 at 4:51 AM, <xcub...@omitsis.com> wrote:
setUserClassesTakesPrecedence


I am using hadoop-2.0.0-cdh4.2.1 and this code in R proves that it is present in this version of Hadoop (a Cloudera 4.2.1 version)

#after loading Rhipe

 w=.jmethods("org.apache.hadoop.mapreduce.Job")
w[grepl("setUserClassesTakesPrecedence",w)]
[1] "public void org.apache.hadoop.mapreduce.Job.setUserClassesTakesPrecedence(boolean)"

Consider using Cloudera?
